sources.title: [PATCH v1 3/4] arm64: dts: qcom: sm8250: Add JPEG encoder node

claims.claim: Add the missing JPEG encoder hardware node in SM8250 DTS so the new qcom-jpeg V4L2 encoder driver can bind and operate on this platform. The node wires the resources expected by the binding and driver, including clocks, power domain, IOMMUs and interconnect paths.
